Experimental Study on the Interaction among Chemotherapy Drugs in Gastric Cancer Cell Line
CHEN Ya-junYE Gu-xiangZENG He-pingZHOU Xiong-wen（ Department of General SurgeryY angpuCentral HospitalShanghai 200090China）Abstract： Objective To evaluate the interaction among chemotherapy drugs in gastric cancer cell line in vitro．Method MT T assay was employed to determine the cytotoxicity（inhibition rate） of single and combined drug of four drugs—5FuADMM MC and CDDP in gastric cancer cell line．T he results from all experiments were analyzed with the CalcuSyn（Biosoft）software．T he associated parameters：my-intIC CI and DRI were calculated．Results It was showed that in gastric cancer cell linethe chemosensitivity sequence for single drug was ADM＞CDDP＞M MC＞5Futhe chemosensitivity sequence for combined drug was MMC＋CDDP＞5Fu＋MMC＞ADM＋MMC＞5Fu＋ADM＞5Fu＋CDDP＞ADM＋CDDP．The synergic effect sequence for combined drug was5Fu＋MMC＞5Fu＋CDDP＞5Fu＋ADM＞MMC＋CDDP＞ ADM＋CDDP．A

陈亚军叶古祥曾和平周雄文上海市杨浦区中心医院普外科上海
Experimental Study on the Interaction among Chemotherapy Drugs in Gastric Cancer Cell Line
CHEN Ya-junYE Gu-xiangZENG He-pingZHOU Xiong-wen（ Department of General SurgeryY angpuCentral HospitalShanghai 200090China）Abstract： Objective To evaluate the interaction among chemotherapy drugs in gastric cancer cell line in vitro．Method MT T assay was employed to determine the cytotoxicity（inhibition rate） of single and combined drug of four drugs—5FuADMM MC and CDDP in gastric cancer cell line．T he results from all experiments were analyzed with the CalcuSyn（Biosoft）software．T he associated parameters：my-intIC CI and DRI were calculated．Results It was showed that in gastric cancer cell linethe chemosensitivity sequence for single drug was ADM＞CDDP＞M MC＞5Futhe chemosensitivity sequence for combined drug was MMC＋CDDP＞5Fu＋MMC＞ADM＋MMC＞5Fu＋ADM＞5Fu＋CDDP＞ADM＋CDDP．The synergic effect sequence for combined drug was5Fu＋MMC＞5Fu＋CDDP＞5Fu＋ADM＞MMC＋CDDP＞ ADM＋CDDP．Analyzed with DRI5Fu＋M MC was the most effective two-drug-combined chemotherapy T he combined chemotherapy of three drugs was obviously more effective than that of two drugs．In threedrug-combined chemotherapythe ratio of 5FuM MC and ADM as200∶1∶1was more effective than that as 100∶1∶1．Conclusions T he combined chemotherapy of three drugs is more superior to that of two drugs 5Fu＋M MC is the most effective two-drug-combined chemotherapy摘要目的利用胃癌细胞株探讨化疗药物的相互作用方法利用法测定四种化疗药的单药和联合用药对胃癌细胞株的抑制率将测得的数据输入电脑用软件处理推算出有关数据斜率截距$\mathrm { I C } _ { 5 0 }$ 联合指数和剂量减少指数结果资料显示胃癌细胞株化疗敏感性顺序 $\mathrm { A D M > _ { C D D P } > M M C > 5 F u ; }$ 联合用药的敏感性顺序 $\mathrm { M \mathrm { M C } + \mathrm { C D D P } \mathrm { \stackrel { \sim } { > } } \mathrm { \tilde { F } u } + \mathrm { M \mathrm { M C } > \mathrm { A D M } + \mathrm { M \mathrm { M C } > \mathrm { \tilde { S } F u } + \mathrm { A D M } \mathrm { \sim } \mathrm { \tilde { S } F u } + \mathrm { C D D P } \mathrm { \stackrel { \sim } { > } } \mathrm { A D M } + \mathrm { C D D P } } } }$ 联合用药协同作用的大小依次为 $\mathrm { . 5 F u ^ { + } M M C { > } \mathrm { { 5 F u ^ { + } C D D P > } \mathrm { { 5 F u ^ { + } A D M > M M C ^ { + } C D D P > A D M ^ { + } C D D P } } } }$ 根据两种药物联合用药DRI分析，以 $5 \mathrm { F u ^ { + } M M C }$ 为最佳;三种药物的联合用药的DRI也明显优于两种药物的联合用药。在三种药物联合使用中和中的配比要比更理想结论三种药物联合用药优于两种药物联合用药在两种药物联合用药中最佳目前临床肿瘤化疗均采用联合化疗联合化疗是利用联合药物之间的协同作用取得比单药更好的效果因此在确定联合化疗方案时需了解联合方案的敏感性和联合药物之间的相互作用找出联合药物的最佳配比目前化疗药敏试验的方法很多基本上都属于单药药敏试验不能显示联合药物的最佳配比［1］近年来在单药药敏试验法的基础上引进计算机技术应用质量作用定律的原理发明了联合药敏试验［2］ 该试验能直接和客观地反映临床所用联合药物的体外敏感性和相互作用预示临床联合化疗的疗效引起了临床医师的极大兴趣［3～5］ 本研究对胃癌细胞株开展联合药敏试验探讨部分化疗药物之间的相互作用和意义
